boundary: Only search, read posts and profiles, and record professional project evidence. No interactions, purchases or contact enrichment.
method: Bounded manual-intent searches with Latest sort, followed by exact personal-profile and project checks. No extensions or automated profile traversal.
counting_rule: Visible top-level post impressions examined per pass, including duplicates across queries. Not unique profiles or search coverage. Profile activity is not counted again. Public agent queries are logged separately and are not summed as distinct people.
